- `initial_list`: List of cell indices, initially sorted by rear-most depth [S1, S2][S3].

The claim states that the initial list is sorted by the 'rear-most depth'. Source [S2] explicitly notes: 'Initial sort: Sort cells from back to front by the depth coordinate of their rear-most vertex.' Source [S3] confirms this: 'The cells are initially sorted from back to front by the depth coordinate of their rear-most vertex.' Source [S1] mentions sorting by the 'z-coordinate of their farthest vertex', which corresponds to the rear-most vertex in a back-to-front sort context (farthest from the viewer). Thus, the evidence supports the claim.
